content:
The execution failed because the cell A1 in the 'Compute Pool #8100' sheet did not contain the expected text 'Nimbus Compute'. 

Trace error: `FAIL: Compute Pool #8100!A1 must be Nimbus Compute`.

This indicates that while the sheet structure and names were correct, the specific header or title required in cell A1 of the detail sheets was either missing or contained different text. The planner should ensure that row 1 of 'Compute Pool #8100' starts with 'Nimbus Compute' and likely 'Nimbus Storage' for the storage sheet, as per the implied title requirements in the test suite.
